name: Tangan Kanojo -Hitotsu-me Shoujo to Gakusei Seikatsu -
original_name: タンガンカノジョ-ひとつ目少女と学生生活-
source:
Due to family circumstances, you've spent your life constantly transferring schools. At your latest school, you find that Nene Araki—the girl you had a crush on back in middle school—is also attending. However, for some reason, Nene now has only one eye and has closed herself off from others. 

Talk to her often and do your best to cheer her up! With time, she'll gradually open her heart to you.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13577]Novelgame[/url]]
